ILanguageServerFacade.Window.LogMessage() is an extension method from OmniSharp LogMessageExtensions. Cannot be verified with Moq directly. Must verify Window property access or use SendNotification mock instead.

ContentPositionIndex.End = Index + Length - 1 (not Index + Length). ZonePivot.FixZoneHeaderLength uses ZoneEnd.End which is off-by-one from naive calculation.

Serilog ILogger.LogError() is an extension method from Server.Common.Models.Logging.Log. It checks logger.IsEnabled(LogEventLevel.Error) first. Mock must set up IsEnabled to return true, then verify Error() call.
BuildPomId(List<string>? ids = null) has optional parameter. Moq expression trees throw CS0854 if you call BuildPomId(null) in Setup. Use BuildPomId(It.IsAny<List<string>>()) instead.
Export(bool justText = false) has optional parameter. Moq expression trees throw CS0854 if you call Export() in Setup. Use Export(It.IsAny<bool>()) instead.

Moq proxies for IUnitNode/IComponentNode cause 'Self referencing loop detected' when passed to Newtonsoft JSON serializer (JObject.FromObject, WriteJson). Use concrete BaseUnitNode/BaseComponentNode instead when the object will be serialized.

UnitType is a read-only computed property (get-only) that delegates to Metadata.UnitType. Cannot set directly on BaseUnitNode. Must either set via Metadata property or leave unset if not needed for the test.

PublishDiagnostics is an extension method (PublishDiagnosticsExtensions.PublishDiagnostics) on ITextDocumentLanguageServer. Cannot be verified with Moq. ClearDiagnostic and PublishDiagnosticAsync both call it. Testing is limited to constructor instantiation unless the underlying interface method is discovered.

LintingGroup.Severity returns bool (Success => FromAudit.Success) not string. The Severity property's return type matches IAuditable.Severity which is string, but Hidden maps to DoNotLint (bool). Be careful with type mapping.

IgnoreCase=true has NO effect. Comparer is set in ctor (before JSON deserializer sets IgnoreCase), so it always stays StringComparison.Ordinal. Comparer is private-set, no OnDeserialized callback. All string comparisons are case-sensitive regardless of IgnoreCase value.

Validate returns false for empty strings (falls through all null-check branches) and for non-string tokens. With no constraints AND no range set, returns false (falls through all checks). First non-null constraint wins — ContainsStr has highest priority, then BeginsWithStr, EndsWithStr, EqualsStr, OneOf.

Today=false is treated as non-null by 'null != Today' check. So Today=false + date-is-not-today → returns false (probably unintended — should only check when Today=true). Only Today=null skips the today check.

Artifact setter casts IArtifact to concrete Artifact: FromArtifact = (Artifact)value. Cannot pass mock IArtifact — will throw InvalidCastException. Must use parameterless ctor and either set FromArtifact directly or let ArtifactType/ArtifactName setters create new Artifact().
ApiResponse.AddToResults has `values.AddRange(values)` — adds parameter list to itself (doubling it) instead of `this.value.AddRange(values)`. Tests document the buggy behavior.

RelatedArtifact.HasArtifactCount: the Artifact_Count branch (line 70) is dead code. Artifact_Count getter returns Artifact_Count_RangeMin, so setting Artifact_Count sets MinimumCount, which makes RangeMin != -777. The 'both are -777 but Artifact_Count is not' condition is logically impossible.

IndexNodeContainer implements IIndexNode (not IIndexNodeContainer). IIndexNode.Parent requires IIndexNodeContainer. So you must use Mock<IIndexNodeContainer> for Parent in tests, not concrete IndexNodeContainer instances.
ContentLine is in Server.Parsing.Models.Parsers.Output.Container.File.Content (NOT .Harness). IContentBase.Lines returns List<ContentLine> from the Content namespace.

FullTextDocument.Update() calls ApplyChanges() but DISCARDS the return value. ApplyChanges does MemberwiseClone and modifies the clone. Content is NOT updated by Update() — only Version, Changes list, and _LineStarts (from unchanged content) are affected. Use Reload() for actual content replacement.

ArtifactTypeFilter.ArtifactTypeStr link type detection requires the value to match RegexQuery.LinkTypes, which is Enum.GetNames<LinkTypeEnum>().Where(e => e.EndsWith("Link")). Valid link types end with "Link" (e.g. "ImageLink", "SnippetLink"). Non-Link values like "Bookmark" fall through to Enum.TryParse on ArtifactEnum.
WriteOperationFieldBase has no parameterless constructor. Must use WriteOperationFieldBase("Name", "Value"). Mock setups returning this type must use the 2-arg constructor.

LookMeUpFields setter calls UnionWith(value) instead of replacing. Setting null throws ArgumentNullException. Setting empty HashSet still retains the 6 default fields. Must use Moq<IWriteOperationConfigurationBase> to test Combine with null/empty LookMeUpFields.

BasicArray.Validate line 45: ContainsStr.Validate(token, logger) passes the outer array JToken instead of `item`. Since ContainsStr is BasicString and BasicString.Validate checks token.Type == JTokenType.String, this always returns false for arrays. The `return true` branch on line 46 is unreachable dead code.

Update() and AddStartsWith() always return false. ConcurrentDictionary.AddOrUpdate uses addValue directly for new keys (lambda never fires), and for existing keys oldValue is never null so reLint=true branch inside if(null != oldValue) else never executes. This appears to be a production bug — the reLint signal is never raised.

ConcurrentHashSet<string> with OrdinalIgnoreCase comparer: xUnit Assert.Contains(item, set) enumerates with default case-sensitive equality, NOT the set's comparer. Use Assert.True(set.Contains(item)) instead to leverage OrdinalIgnoreCase.

AuditorSchemaService has constructor AuditorSchemaService(AuditorService auditor) — no parameterless ctor. Moq cannot proxy it even with new Mock<AuditorSchemaService>(null!) because Castle.DynamicProxy fails. Pass null! directly instead of mocking.
